title: Core equation-count comparison presentation
statement: Core presentation and localization comparison theorem

proof.text: Use FinitePresentation.out to choose a surjective polynomial presentation φ in n variables with finitely generated kernel I. Apply the bounded-local-kernel-generators theorem to obtain c≤n, equations f, their span J⊆I, and equality JA=IA at A=P_{φ⁻¹(q)}.

The proved private helper exists_multiplier_of_localized_le uses Mathlib IsLocalization.algebraMap_mem_map_algebraMap_iff on each generator of the finite ideal I. A finite-product induction gives a common multiplier s outside φ⁻¹(q) with s times each generator in J. Ideal-span induction gives sI⊆J. The empty family uses s=1.

Construct T=P/J and its algebra map π to S by Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ using J⊆ker φ. Surjectivity follows by lifting through φ. Put u=[s]; π(u)=φ(s) is outside q. For x in ker π choose a polynomial representative a. Then a∈I and s*a∈J, so u*x=0 in T. IsLocalization.Away.map_injective_iff gives injectivity of the localized map (exponent 1). IsLocalization.Away.mapₐ_surjective_of_surjective gives surjectivity. Return this bijection and c≤n.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_equationCount_comparison_core
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (q : PrimeSpectrum S)
    (hfp : FinitePresentation R S)
    (hflat : (Localization.localRingHom (q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R S)) q.asIdeal
      (algebraMap R S) rfl).Flat)
    (hci : ∃ h : (q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R S)).Fiber S,
      h ∉ (PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber R S (q.comap (algebraMap R S))
        ⟨q, rfl⟩).asIdeal ∧
      IsGlobalCompleteIntersection (q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R S)).ResidueField
        (Localization.Away h)) :
    ∃ (n c : ℕ) (f : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R),
      let T := MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f)
      ∃ (π : T →ₐ[R] S) (u : T),
        Function.Surjective π ∧ π u ∉ q.asIdeal ∧
        Function.Bijective
          (IsLocalization.Away.mapₐ (Localization.Away u) (Localization.Away (π u)) π u) ∧
        c ≤ n
